methods.bill: Published monthly consumer-band unit prices. Energy and distribution exclude tax; the tax channel includes electricity excise and VAT. Published total retained. Annualised illustration = authored annual kWh × selected-month c/kWh / 100. No extra VAT, invented load profile or causal price model.
methods.grid: Energiateollisuus 2024 worksheet. Hour labels 1–24 interpreted as hour-ending slots in publisher fixed UTC+2 normal time; end = source date + hour, start = end − 1 h. No daylight-saving adjustment. MW are treated as hourly means. Energy = sum(MW × 1 h); no trapezoidal integration. Exports are signed negative in the source. Balance = production + import + signed export − consumption. These are national flows, not available capacity.
methods.heat: Published 2024 Nivos company/municipal row 114. Thermal GWh retained separately from electrical MWh. Recovered heat / heat-pump output is a combined source category, not pure server waste heat. Residential use is reported directly, not allocated by fuel mix. 2025 company sales (43.1 GWh) transcribed from report PDF page 3; central-network origin share (41%) transcribed from the pinned origin disclosure. Different scopes; no multiplication across them.
methods.branch: Authored extra whole-facility MW is added arithmetically to a historical national demand observation. The unmet-by-fixed-historical-supply increment is a requirement to investigate, not a forecast of imports, generation, blackouts, grid capacity or price. No PUE multiplier.
